text: uh now so if i map uv to a texture image when then exporting it does it only take from the image exactly what is needed for the uv or is it carrying it all?
resolution: Inspected the active editor's texture import, model-package writer, and compiled resident-mesh export paths to answer the export-semantics question. The current implementation adopts the complete imported raster at native dimensions, writes the complete live atlas to atlases/base.png, and embeds that entire encoded PNG in the exported resident mesh; UVs limit sampling only, and no crop or island repack occurs. No code change was requested or made.
